svg.data-regions-by: Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-01: re-drafted under profile 2 by a script of Claude's from the draft of the same day. Each region's ink is what a watershed on the photograph's luminance gives its seeds: the seeds of the draft's regions that were in one group, those lent to one letter, or to a sign of one written part, joined as one region; and seeds that Claude placed by eye, with the transcription in hand, in written parts that had none and near junctions. The draft's cuts and its regions in two groups are dropped. The groups' ids, kinds, owners and notes, and the supplied ink's reasons, are the draft's, but where a group's note says otherwise; an id sN in them names a stroke of the stroke-SVG. Strips of vellum whose reason says so are proposed by the script, where the boundary between two signs' regions is pale. Ben drew the line of the strip v1 on 2026-11-01, as the draft's cut c11. Claude drew the cut c12 from Ben's words of the same day, so that the qamats's dot is a region of its own beside its bar. On 2026-11-02 the tip at the crop's foot, which the re-draft had joined to the silluq's region rg12, became the region rg16 and the group g10 of the line below, from Ben's words of 2026-11-01 (statement 72).

path.data-why: Ben's, drawn on 2026-11-01 as the cut c11 (statement 62): the pe and the nun do not touch, and a thin strip of vellum, which level 1's fill covers, runs between them; the re-draft makes his line a strip of vellum

path.data-note: Claude's, from Ben's words of 2026-11-01 (statement 63): the qamats's dot is a region of its own, which touches the bar above it only as a circle touches a tangent; the cut runs along the bar's lower edge

the תחתון strand's vowel: the right bar and the dot under it

line 21's: the top of the left leg of the first letter of Exodus 20:4's atom 6, which the crop's foot cuts. Ben read it as the tip of another line's letter (statement 72 of 2026-11-01), and Claude found the letter in the page image; the re-draft of 2026-11-01 had joined it to the silluq's region rg12
